test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which mobile app won the National e-Governance Award 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IRCTC Rail Connect**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National e-Governance Award 2019**

 
 
• At a gathering hosted by the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG),** Dr. Jitendra Singh presented the 2019 National e-Governance Awards**.
 
• The Government of India **annually presents National Awards on e-Governance with the goal of recognising and promoting Excellence in the implementation of e-Governance programs**. 
 
• In order to acknowledge accomplishments in the field of e-Governance,** 14 Awards were granted in 6 categories**, with Gold and Silver Awards in each.
 
• **IRCTC Rail Connect Mobile App** also received a Special Jury Award in Category-I.
 
• The event also featured presentations on some of the honoured projects, including **Hello Doctor 555, Punarvas, the MDDA ERP, the IRCTC Rail Connect Mobile App, and UMANG**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National e-Governance Award**

 
 
• The National e-Governance Award honours some of the outstanding **government-to-government (G to G), government-to-citizen (G to C), and government-to-business (G to B)** efforts undertaken by government departments.
 
• It also honors endeavors in **start-ups, academic research institutions, and the use of cutting-edge technologies**.
 
• The focus is on **Citizen Centric Services and the use of technology** to promote development. 
 
 
 
• **IRCTC Rail Connect** is a free app that is only accessible on Android, falls under the** "Travel & Navigation" category,** and was created by IRCTC Official.
